name: clinica-pet-linear
description:
Affine registration of PET images to the MNI standard space.

   ACQ_LABEL corresponds the label given to the PET acquisition, specifying the tracer used.
Frequently used values are '18FFDG' or '18FAV45'.

   The reference region must be specified to perform intensity normalization.
Accepted values include: 'pons', 'cerebellumPons', 'pons2', 'cerebellumPons2'.

Prerequisite: You need to have performed the t1-linear pipeline on your T1-weighted MR images.

See https://aramislab.paris.inria.fr/clinica/docs/public/latest/Pipelines/PET_Linear/"

inputs.description: Select the PET scans based on the reconstruction method. If unset, PET scans will be selected independently of the reconstruction method.
inputs.name: reconstruction_method

inputs.description: Do not crop the image with template (cropped image are suggested for using with DL models)
inputs.name: uncropped_image

inputs.description: Save the PET image in the T1w space computed in the intermediate step of the pipeline
inputs.name: save_pet_in_t1w_space

inputs.description: Specify the random seed for algorithms that support it.
inputs.name: random_seed

inputs.description: TSV file containing a list of subjects with their sessions.
inputs.name: subjects_sessions_tsv

inputs.description: Temporary directory to store pipelines intermediate results.
inputs.name: working_directory

inputs.description: Number of cores used to run in parallel.
inputs.name: n_procs
